name: gem-rush
description: Gem Rush — a full-stack, server-authoritative 5x3 video slot built as a portfolio piece.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @gem-rush/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @gem-rush/server" "npm run dev -w @gem-rush/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gem-rush/shared && npm run build -w @gem-rush/server && npm run build -w @gem-rush/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @gem-rush/shared && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/client --noEmit && tsc -p packages/client/tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.simulate: npm run build -w @gem-rush/shared && npm run simulate -w @gem-rush/server
